etymology.historical_story: Sagayam is attested as a personal-name element in Malaysian reporting. A possible Tamil connection is சகாயம், recorded in the University of Madras Tamil Lexicon with meanings including help and support, and traced there to Sanskrit sahāya. That connection is plausible background, not a verified derivation of this packet's unidentified token or evidence of a Malay common-noun sense. [Malaysian name use](https://www.malaysiakini.com/news/479007), [Tamil Lexicon reproduction](https://www.tamilsurangam.in/tamil_dictionary/chennai_univercity_tamil_lexicon_dictionary/chennai_univercity_tamil_lexicon_dictionary_1219.html).

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 称呼真实人物时，应核实本人姓名拼写、读音及偏好的称呼。适用时可使用 Encik 等礼貌称谓，不凭名字推断宗教或身份。
